entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you're speaking with Sarah at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hello, Sarah. I... I'm calling because I'd like to return my VeloBand Pulse. I'm just so disappointed with it.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the band?

It's not broken or anything. I just find it really hard to use. The menu system is so confusing. I even read the user manual front to back, but I just... I really expected more. It's not intuitive at all.
I see. I'm sorry the experience hasn't met your expectations. I can definitely check on the return eligibility for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Yes, it's VF-pulse-88761. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time, and this is the first time I've ever felt let down. I really needed this money back, I was hoping this would be a great investment.
Thank you for that. I appreciate your loyalty, and I'll do my best to help. Let me just pull up your order... Okay, I see it was delivered 23 days ago. Let me just check our return policy.

Okay, thanks for holding. I've checked our system, and it looks like our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. You're well within that window, so I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund for you immediately.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief! Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried. That's wonderful news.

Of course, I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just place the device back in its original packaging, affix the label, and you can drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed. Can I help with anything else?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thank you!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
